headline: New book claims Jared Kushner received billions from Saudi and Emirati governments
label: NEWS
caption:
A new explosive book alleges that Jared Kushner received approximately 2 billion dollars from Saudi and Emirati governments.

According to journalist Matthew Cole, 750 million dollars was held at First Abu Dhabi Bank through an Emirati charity and used for weapons purchases and covert military operations. Jared Kushner has vociferously denied these claims.

Princes and Thieves also makes numerous allegations regarding the UAE ruling family and regional political maneuvering.

Should political figures face investigations over foreign financial dealings and book allegations?
